ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Rachel Carson Synthetic CCD — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

text.paragraph: Primary care visit for a new left breast lump; follow-up of a recently treated duodenal ulcer. Concerns: A firm lump in the left breast she found two weeks ago; Wants to be told plainly and in person what any test shows, to see the reports herself, and to make her own decisions; asks that her health be shared only with the people she chooses; Worried that illness will keep her from finishing her book. [S]

tr.td: Diagnostic mammography of the left breast with a right breast view: 2.4 cm irregular spiculated mass at 2 o'clock in the upper outer left breast; scattered fibroglandular density; right breast normal; BI-RADS 5
Left breast and axillary ultrasound: 2.4 cm irregular hypoechoic mass at 2 o'clock, 7 cm from the nipple; axillary lymph nodes normal in size and shape
Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy of the left breast mass with clip placement: invasive ductal carcinoma, grade 2; ER 95 percent, PR 80 percent, HER2 1+ (negative), Ki-67 22 percent
Genetic counseling and germline multigene panel testing for inherited breast cancer risk: no pathogenic variant

Left breast lumpectomy (breast-conserving surgery) with wire-free localization of the biopsy clip, her informed choice. Pathology: invasive ductal carcinoma 2.3 cm, grade 2, margins clear (closest 4 mm), no lymphovascular invasion; pT2. Recurrence score (21-gene assay) 17
Left axillary sentinel lymph node biopsy at lumpectomy: 2 of 3 nodes with macrometastases (largest 6 mm), no extranodal extension; pN1a(sn)
13C urea breath test four weeks after bismuth quadruple therapy and two weeks after stopping omeprazole: negative; Helicobacter pylori eradicated
Hypofractionated radiation to the left whole breast and regional lymph nodes, 40 Gy in 15 fractions, with a tumor-bed boost of 10 Gy in 4 fractions; completed with grade 1 skin reddening
Baseline bone density scan (DXA) before letrozole: lumbar spine T-score -1.8, femoral neck T-score -1.3 (low bone mass)
Baseline 12-lead electrocardiogram before ribociclib: sinus rhythm 70/min, QTcF 418 ms

tr.td: Primary care visit for a new left breast lump; follow-up of a recently treated duodenal ulcer
Disclosure of the biopsy diagnosis of breast cancer and shared decision-making, with the breast surgical oncology consultation the same day
Review two weeks after lumpectomy and sentinel node biopsy: full disclosure of the pathology and the adjuvant treatment decision
Start of letrozole, ribociclib, and zoledronic acid after radiation
Monitoring visit at the start of the fourth ribociclib cycle
Same-day sick visit for sinus symptoms on ribociclib

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

tr.td: Diagnostic mammography and ultrasound of the left breast and axilla this week, then image-guided core biopsy with ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 testing
Breast surgical oncology consultation once the biopsy result is available, to discuss surgical options and axillary staging with her

Disclosure and shared decision-making: ask what she wants to know, give each result in person and in plain words with a written copy, check understanding by teach-back, and make every decision with her; share her health information only with the people she names
Test of cure for Helicobacter pylori by urea breath test at least four weeks after antibiotics and two weeks after stopping omeprazole
Knee osteoarthritis: walking and strengthening exercise, acetaminophen as needed, no nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs after her ulcer
Germline multigene panel testing with genetic counseling before surgery, as recommended for breast cancer diagnosed at 65 or younger

Left breast-conserving surgery (lumpectomy) with sentinel lymph node biopsy, her choice after mastectomy was also explained; no axillary dissection if one or two sentinel nodes are involved and she has whole-breast radiation
Hypofractionated whole-breast and regional nodal radiation with a tumor-bed boost by the radiation oncology team, booked in the afternoons so she can write in the mornings

Letrozole 2.5 mg daily for at least five years with ribociclib 400 mg on days 1 to 21 of each 28-day cycle for three years, chosen by her; no chemotherapy with a recurrence score of 17; ECG before starting and about day 14, blood counts and liver tests every two weeks for two cycles and then at the start of the next four cycles, and electrolytes at the start of the first six cycles; avoid drugs that prolong the QT interval
Bone health: baseline DXA, dental check, then zoledronic acid 4 mg every six months for three years; vitamin D and calcium from food; weight-bearing exercise; DXA every two years

Survivorship care: history and examination every 3 to 6 months, a mammogram 6 to 12 months after radiation and then yearly, no routine tumor markers or body imaging; lymphedema checks, joint-pain and hot-flash review, distress screening, and a written survivorship care plan
Receive the biopsy result in person within ten days, explained in plain words, with a copy of the report
Told the diagnosis in person nine days after presentation, with the pathology report in hand; teach-back confirmed her understanding
Make each treatment decision herself after hearing the options, benefits, and harms
Chose breast-conserving surgery and, after the pathology, radiation, letrozole, ribociclib, and zoledronic acid
Complete surgery and radiation, then start endocrine therapy, within four months of diagnosis
Lumpectomy at three weeks, radiation completed at ten weeks, letrozole and ribociclib started at thirteen weeks
Take adjuvant systemic therapy safely, with every safety check the drugs require done on schedule
Ribociclib started with QTcF 418 ms; blood counts and liver tests on schedule; the day-14 ECG was late, as recorded
Keep writing at least four mornings a week through treatment
Writing most mornings, with radiation booked in the afternoons
